name: TAT-QA: Table And Text Question Answering in Finance
description: TAT-QA (Table And Text Question Answering) is a specialized financial reasoning benchmark based on real financial reports from publicly traded companies. It consists of 16,552 questions paired with 2,757 hybrid contexts containing semi-structured financial tables and unstructured explanatory text, where answering requires numerical calculations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, ratio, percentage change) across both modalities.
